capability_if_all_winners_in_pool.method: all 792 equally likely 5-subsets of the frozen Top-12 pool as hypothetical winner sets, scored against the frozen challenger tickets (no ticket constructed from the outcome)

classification: D (ordinary random variation) with a discovery shortfall: the Top-12 pool captured 1 winner (random expectation 1.71; P(<=1) = 0.43). Construction captured the only in-pool winner (11). With every credibility 0 the construction is coverage-driven and cannot concentrate winners beyond chance.
